event_v0.doc: Emitted on every settlement so a payment is attributable from chain data\nalone. `payer` is a topic (indexable); the rest is the settlement breakdown.
event_v0.name: Settle

function_v0.doc:
Settle one capability call.

Moves `amount` of `token` from `payer` to `builder` (the capability's
payout) and `fee` of `token` from `payer` to `fee_to` (Tael's fee wallet),
atomically. `payer` must authorize the call, so no one can move an agent's
funds without its Card's signature. A `settle` event is emitted with the
full breakdown.

* `token`   - the token contract address (the USDC Stellar Asset Contract)
* `payer`   - the agent's Card (funds source; must authorize)
* `builder` - the capability builder's payout address
* `fee_to`  - Tael's fee wallet
* `amount`  - the builder's share (must be > 0)
* `fee`     - Tael's fee (>= 0; skipped if 0)
function_v0.name: settle
